clips.start_words: I was applying for a job
clips.caption:
A caller once phoned a radio show just to thank Kevin Trudeau for his best business decision ever.

500 people applied for the same Wall Street job. To stand apart, he memorized every interviewer's name, then all 1,500 NYSE companies and stock symbols.

Executives started pulling each other in just to watch him recall it live.

He got the job. Three promotions followed. He still isn't sure if people think he's smart, or just impossible to forget.

What would one remembered detail do for your next interview?

#kevintrudeau #memory #careeradvice #jobinterview #success #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau ran a real experiment on one ordinary seventh grade class.

Nine hours of memory training. Nothing else about their curriculum changed.

By the end of the year they were eight months ahead of schedule, averaging A-minus, and reading at a college sophomore's vocabulary level.

The strangest number wasn't the grades, though. It was attendance: almost zero absences, because the kids finally wanted to be at school.

Grades tend to follow confidence, not the other way around.

#kevintrudeau #memory #education #learning #confidence #mindset

A mother stood up in front of 500 people at one of Kevin Trudeau's seminars to tell this story.

Her daughter failed a history exam so badly her teacher told her, in front of the whole class, that she must be stupid.

Three days into a memory course, that same girl walked back into that classroom and recited all 50 states and capitals in order, backwards included.

Then she looked her teacher in the eye and handed the insult back.

Confidence came back before a single grade did. Which one shows up first for you?

#kevintrudeau #memory #confidence #parenting #education #selfesteem

A college student walked into Kevin Trudeau's class with one request: I'm flunking calculus, can you help.

He couldn't hold equations in his head long enough to use them on an exam.

One lesson on memorizing formulas later, he scored 100 percent, the only student in the class to do it, in a tenth of the usual time.

His professor assumed he'd cheated and sent him to the principal's office. He walked out with an invite to train the staff instead.

Sometimes the fix isn't more study time, it's a better way to hold what you learned.

#kevintrudeau #memory #studytips #college #learning #mindset

Kevin Trudeau says he once tested his memory against a casino, on purpose.

Single deck blackjack, no gimmicks: he tracked every card already played, calculated exactly what remained in the deck, and hit on 17 when the math said to, against basic strategy.

An hour later he'd won $250,000. Then two men tapped him on the shoulder.

The owner let him keep every dollar of it. He just banned him from the tables for being too good to beat.

A mind that keeps score can outlast a pit boss.

#kevintrudeau #memory #blackjack #casino #mindset #wealthmindset

Years after his Reno win, Kevin Trudeau sat down at a blackjack table in Australia with General Norman Schwartzkopf.

The dealer dealt cards to the general. Not to him.

When he asked why, the casino told him he was listed in something called the Griffin book: a registry of players who never cheat, but count well enough to get barred anyway.

Two countries, two casinos, the same verdict on the same memory.

Being the best player at the table isn't always the same as being welcome at it.

#kevintrudeau #memory #casino #blackjack #mindset #success

Kevin Trudeau once offered an entire school district free memory training worth millions of dollars.

Every teacher, every student, no cost to the district, in exchange for the publicity.

Chicago turned him down. Word was the teachers' union worried that students who could actually remember what they were taught might need fewer teachers to reteach it.

He never got confirmation that was the real reason. He only got the no.

If it's true, whose job security won that vote: the students' or the system's?

#kevintrudeau #memory #education #schools #learning #mindset

Kevin Trudeau met Australian billionaire Rene Rifkin for maybe two minutes at a cocktail party.

Two days later, in a hotel elevator, Rifkin's bodyguard was standing just out of sight behind him.

Kevin greeted Rifkin and his assistant by name, then named the bodyguard too, a man he'd barely glimpsed once.

Rifkin was stunned enough to invite him home for dinner. That dinner turned into a business deal worth over $200 million.

A name remembered can outperform a pitch rehearsed for weeks.

#kevintrudeau #memory #networking #business #wealthmindset #success
